lidar.roof: flat, single plane; 2025 ortho shows white membrane largely covered by PV arrays + 3 rooftop enclosures

method: Independent second pass. All 25 files in data/photos/howard_tilton (24 *.jpg + Tulane_U_Mch2013_HT_Library_Back.JPG) viewed, plus the 4 rights-reserved Tulane campus-map references (used as visual reference only). Colours = median RGB / CIELAB of hand-placed boxes verified on a contact sheet, plus k-means separation of mixed zones and pixel filters (sky-exclusion, red-only, bright-only); scripts in scratchpad/ht2/{measure.py,kmeans.py}. Albedo estimates calibrated against a white food-truck side in the same light (2019 photo) and a white pickup (2018 overcast). Bay counts from a projective fit of loggia-fin x-positions in the Feb-2026 photo (fins at x=1645,1302,1054,868,723,608,513,433,365 -> predicted 308,258,214 -> 11 bays to the far corner), the original Newcomb Place elevation drawing (11 bays, 6 windows per bay) and the 2025 ortho (11 teeth on the ESE edge).

storeys.treatment: ground floor on a ~1.0 m exposed-aggregate plinth; continuous bronze-tinted storefront recessed ~1.5 m behind wide precast piers under a dark soffit; precast planter boxes on the podium
fin floor: projecting precast fins + wide structural piers; tall narrow windows
fin floor, windows stack over storey 2; dark red-brown spandrel strip at the floor line recessed behind the fins

terrace floor: continuous glazing set ~1.5-2 m back behind a precast balustrade (rail on squat posts); deep flat roof slab overhang with pale fascia ~0.7 m and exposed beam ends (original roof, now the cornice under the addition, top at ~17.7 m)
2014-16 addition: light silver-grey metal-panel box; ESE face = 11-bay deep loggia
as storey 5 (one 2-storey volume, ~10.7 m incl. coping)

wall.material: precast concrete with exposed light aggregate (fine pebbly / lightly sandblasted finish, buff-white matrix with grey-cream speckle), expressed as ~1.2 m wide structural piers and ~0.5 m projecting vertical fins with flat recessed panels; same on all four faces of storeys 1-4

wall.vs_model_constant: build_model WALL #d6cec2 Lab(83,0.6,7.2) is lighter and yellower; real wall is a greyer, slightly darker off-white (b* ~4.5) with strong vertical fin shadows

Pale precast balustrade at storey 4 and the roof-slab fascia are wall-coloured.

glazing.notes: upper windows: neutral dark-grey glass in dark-bronze anodised frames (reads sky-blue in direct sun, near-black in shade); ground floor: bronze/amber-tinted storefront that reads tan in sun with interior visible

ground_floor.description: continuous full-height storefront between piers, mullions ~1.4-1.6 m (4-6 lights per bay), recessed ~1.5 m under a dark soffit, beige curtains inside

terrace_floor.description: storey 4: continuous glazing behind the balustrade; reads as a dark void under the overhang

ESE_campus_face.layout: 6 evenly spaced tall windows per bay per fin floor (66 per floor), each flanked by a ~0.5 m fin; transom ~1/3 down

SSW_NNE_WNW_faces.layout: 3 pairs of narrow lights per bay (6 lights) with a narrow fin inside each pair and a wider fin between pairs; red-brown panel in the bottom ~20-25% of each light; a few positions hold pale louvred vents

pattern.stacked: storey-2 and storey-3 windows align vertically with a ~0.3 m spandrel/notch at the floor line

measured: 2007 sunlit face dark-glass px #2a2b2b, slit glass #393630

base.material: exposed-aggregate precast plinth / podium ~1.0 m high (coarser pebble texture than the walls) with a projecting slab edge; continuous precast planter boxes on the podium in front of the storefront; entrance steps + ramp with metal rails on the ESE side near the Freret corner; lawn and sidewalk; iron picket fence along Freret and Newcomb Place
measured: Feb-2026 sunlit plinth bright px #c0a89b Lab(70.6,6.6,9.9)

roof_edge.description: original flat roof slab projects ~1.5-2 m beyond the storey-4 glazing with a pale precast fascia ~0.6-0.7 m tall, exposed beam ends and a dark soffit; the balustrade (~1.0 m) sits ~1 m inside the slab edge. This slab is now a continuous cornice band under the addition; the addition wall sits ~1-1.5 m inside it on the WNW/SSW/NNE sides (light strip visible in the ortho), while the ESE loggia fins reach the slab edge.
roof_edge.addition_roof_edge: flush thin light-metal coping/fascia (~0.4 m), no parapet upstand, no overhang; roof = white membrane with large PV arrays and 2-3 mechanical enclosures (LiDAR height:max 32.6 m)

upper_addition.built: 2014-2016 (Dec-2014 photo: 2-storey frame under red weather barrier)
upper_addition.material: flat light silver-grey aluminium (composite) panels with vertical joints ~1.0-1.2 m, satin finish that reflects the sky (reads white in direct sun, pale blue-grey in overcast/shade). ESE (campus) face = 11-bay loggia: deep (~2.5 m) white/light-grey aluminium fin frames with fastener rows along the edges, dark-charcoal ribbed/perforated metal jambs and soffits inside the recesses, dark-tinted curtain-wall glazing on the back wall (both storeys). SSW (Freret) face: flat panel with a group of 4 full-height slot windows near the east end and, probably, 2-3 loggia-type recessed bays at the west end. WNW face: flat panel with 2-3 slots. NNE face: flat panel with a few slots (not directly verified).
measured: 2018 overcast panel bright px #b5bfc8 Lab(76.8,-1.7,-5.7) (white pickup side in same frame #9b9da1 -> panel is brighter than white paint = light + specular sky)

render_recommendations: split the wall material at z~17.7 m: lower = off-white precast #c2beb6 with a fin-shadow texture (fins every ~1.3 m on ESE, paired slits elsewhere), upper = light silver-grey metal #c8cdd3 with some specular/sky reflection
ESE face of the addition: 11 dark recessed bays (#23262b interior, #e6e8ea fins), not a flat panel
ground floor: dark bronze storefront recessed behind piers on a 1 m plinth with planters
dark red-brown strips at the storey-3/4 line and over the storefront; red-brown sill panels on slit faces

second_pass_disagreements_with_pass1: 1. trim / sill panels (pass 1 sill_band false, 'not seen after the 2013-14 reglazing'): DISAGREE. Nov-2021 Freret-face photo (-04) at 2x shows a red-brown panel in the bottom ~20-25% of every narrow light (measured #826959 backlit), exactly as in Dec-2007. The 2019 NNE/WNW-face photo lacks them, so it is face-specific: keep the panels on the SSW (Freret) face at least.

2. glazing.pattern on the ESE face (pass 1: one rhythm everywhere, 3 units per 7.9 m bay, pitch 2.6 m, window 0.85 m, 33 per long side): DISAGREE for ESE. Feb-2026 4x zoom and the Newcomb Place elevation drawing show 6 evenly spaced tall windows per bay (pitch ~1.3 m, window ~0.75 m, fins ~0.5 m) -> 66 per floor on ESE. On the slit faces the 0.85 m unit is a PAIR of ~0.4 m lights; '33' is consistent only if a pair counts as one window.

3. upper_addition SSW (Freret) face layout (pass 1: flat panel + 4-5 slots only; 'other three edges are plain' settled by the ortho): PARTIAL DISAGREE. Tulane dusk photo (restricted_reference/c3d_HTML_pic_3.jpg) shows flat panel -> 4 slots -> 2-3 deep loggia-type recessed bays toward the west end; the same 2-3-bay run next to a slotted flat face appears in Zimple_Street_2018 and Newcomb_Blvd_2019 18/19. The ortho cannot exclude recesses because the loggia has a continuous top fascia. West-end recesses on the Freret face at 0.5 confidence.

4. Face labels of Zimple_Street_2018 and the 29-March-2019 portrait (pass 1: NNE 'Zimple' face): DISAGREE (0.6). Zimpel St dead-ends at Audubon St west of the building; from there only the WNW 87 m face is frontal. Both photos = WNW flank; the NNE face is unverified in the set.

5. ground-floor glazing tint (pass 1 #312a25 from a deep-shade sample): MINOR. Storefront reads tan/bronze in sun (2007 #776e57 / #807356, 2016 #4c4d40); use #5a4f3d and let the recess shadow darken it.
6. window frame hue (pass 1 #1a1a14 from a clipped 2001 sample): MINOR. 2007 and Feb-2026 zooms show dark-bronze anodised frames -> #2f2a25.
7. trim base colour (pass 1 #4a3028 = Feb-2026 lintel in shadow): MINOR. Even-light 2019 sample #635041; base #5b4538, shade #3a2c26.

8. addition panel base colour (pass 1 #b4bec6 overcast, sunlit #c0d3e9): MINOR / material-model. Blue is specular sky reflection on satin metal, not pigment; base should be a lighter neutral grey (#c8cdd3) with specularity.

9. colour_measurements labelling (pass 1 'roof-slab fascia (original), sunlit' #766254 marked reliable): DISAGREE. That box is the shaded soffit/brown band; the sky-excluded bright pixels give #bdbec0 (pale fascia). 'terrace balustrade rail' #3a4057 and 'ADDITION loggia fin, sunlit face' #0c121e are likewise mis-hits (flagged unreliable).
10. storey heights (pass 1 sums to 27.3 m vs LiDAR 28.4): MINOR. Photo proportions put the original at ~17.7 m and the addition at ~10.7 m.
second_pass_agreements_with_pass1: wall colour (#c2beb6 vs #c0bdb5), wall material, 11 structural bays on the long sides, ESE loggia of 11 bays only on the ESE face, 6 storeys = 4 original + 2 addition, oxblood band description, plinth/planters, roof-slab cornice and flush addition coping, addition setback on the non-loggia sides.
